notes.title: Around the Week Long Deal, 75% OFF
notes.content:
Dear word enthusiasts,


For a limited time only, Around the Words will be sold on the Steam Store at $0.99. Promotion starts today à 10:00 PDT !

Around the Words is a challenging vocabulary game supported in 8 languages.
So many possibilities for such a low price, you cannot miss it !

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29971581/67bf14cd8cdf2d5b65603abbcc2e83f2c3682476.png[/img]
